open_questions.q: When --summary-name-attributes is supplied, does it replace or extend the built-in generic candidate order?
open_questions.assumed: It replaces the built-in ordered list for generic fallback naming; missing, null, empty, object, and collection values are skipped so the next candidate can be tried.

open_questions.q: Should known-after-apply hints follow each.value, each.key, or count.index through locals and collection expressions to find an underlying resource?
open_questions.assumed: No. This bounded feature suppresses bare or module-qualified pseudo references but keeps specific hints such as each.value.group_object_id and existing meaningful resource, variable, and local references.

open_questions.q: What label should Refactoring Summary use when a generic display identity is available?
open_questions.assumed: Always show the full Terraform resource address as the stable label and append the resolved display identity when one is available.

open_questions.q: How should unchanged msgraph provider metadata be de-emphasized without hiding review information?
open_questions.assumed: Place api_version, url, and ignore_missing_property in a collapsed provider-settings area when unchanged; if any of them changes, render that change with ordinary changed attributes and include it in change counts.

open_questions.q: Which outputs are affected by changed-output filtering?
open_questions.assumed: The opt-in filter applies to root and module output sections and removes only outputs whose Terraform action is no-op; changed, created, deleted, sensitive, and known-after-apply outputs retain existing rendering.
